about1: Prays lɛvɛl dɛn kɔmɔt frɔm di Wol Bank (haushol kɔnsɔmshɔn prayz lɛvɛl, mɔs pan dɛn na 2024; US = 100, we dɛn kip as 1.0). Exchange rates de layv tide. Wan kɔntri in ɔfishal kɔst = US kɔst × in 2024 os PPP, tɔn to dɔla pan tide in ret. Ɔfishal prayz na kɔst fɔ liv, nɔto wan grosa ɛn nɔto tide waya ret. Tayp prayz we dɛn no di rial wan (dɛn sho am as “yu prayz”).
about2: yuz rial makit rays prayz insted ɔf di prayz lɛvɛl: US frɔm di Biro fɔ Leba Statistikin (siris APU0000701312, US siti avɛrej), Haiti ɛn Malawi frɔm di Wɔl Fɔd Program (via HDX). Dɛn kin tɔn lokal prayz to dɔla bay di layv ret tide. 20 lb = 9,07 kg. Kɔntri dɛn we nɔ gɛt makit rays prayz de yuz di prayz lɛvɛl.
about3: Wishlist prayz na di Wol Food Program rital makit prayz (via HDX) fɔ di mishɔn in eria, wit di makit ɛn mɔnt we dɛn sho pan ɛni tin. Di tin dɛn we nɔ gɛt makit prays se “prayz we dɛn sɛt bay mishɔn”.
